title: sida acuta var. carpinifolia
intro: Sida acuta var. carpinifolia, commonly known as the spiny sida, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sida acuta var. carpinifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
